# Version 4.156.0 (Unreleased)
> **Platform reliability and performance**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.156.0 improves platform compatibility, native-library reliability, and allocation behavior across common rendering workloads. Apple deployment support moves to current native baselines, WebAssembly applications can link C sources again, and Android texture rendering now follows display timing. The release also fixes Linux HarfBuzz symbol conflicts and reduces allocations in image and text processing.

## Breaking Changes

- **Apple native deployment baselines increased** — Native libraries now require macOS 11.0 or iOS, tvOS, and Mac Catalyst 14.0. Update applications that target older Apple operating-system versions before adopting this release. ([#5383](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5383))

## Bug Fixes

- **Linux HarfBuzz calls stay within the bundled library** — Prevents font-initialization crashes when a system HarfBuzz library was loaded globally before HarfBuzzSharp. — ❤️ [@VirgilMing](https://github.com/VirgilMing) ([#5352](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5352))
- **Android texture rendering follows display frames** — Continuous GLTextureView and MAUI SKGLView rendering is paced by display callbacks instead of repeatedly swapping as fast as possible, while explicit render requests remain responsive. ([#5345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5345))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Front-buffered streams no longer retain borrowed streams** — Disposing an SKFrontBufferedManagedStream now releases its reference to a caller-owned SKStream without disposing that stream. ([#5327](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5327))
- **Image pixel copies allocate less** — SKImage.FromPixelCopy avoids a temporary SKData wrapper when managed pixel data is valid, reducing overhead without changing results. ([#5052](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5052))
- **HarfBuzz text helpers reduce temporary allocations** — UTF-32 shaping buffers are pooled and feature formatting avoids a native feature-string allocation while preserving existing decoding behavior. ([#5060](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5060), [#5230](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5230))

## Platform

- **Apple platform support aligns with current native baselines** — Native packages now support macOS 11.0 and iOS, tvOS, and Mac Catalyst 14.0 or later. ([#5383](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5383))
- **WebAssembly applications can link C sources** — The WebGPU C++ port is bundled into libSkiaSharp.a, removing C++ compiler flags from application link lines so WebAssembly projects that link C sources build successfully. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5316](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5316))
